item.text: I identified the asymmetric-tensor partition used here: it is determined by the rotational coefficient versus anisotropic stretching, giving the four real/complex, clockwise/counterclockwise regions. I’m now rasterizing that partition at exactly 10 samples per grid square and locating/classifying its degenerate points from the piecewise-linear symmetric component.
